title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
authors: L. Ouyang, J. Wu, X. Jiang, et al. (20 authors)
before: GPT-3 was capable but continued your text instead of doing what you asked.
problem: Likelihood on web text is not the same objective as being useful to a person.
breakthrough: Supervised fine-tuning on demonstrations, then a reward model from human rankings, then PPO against it.
why: A 1.3B InstructGPT was preferred to the 175B base model. Alignment elicits and steers capability rather than adding knowledge.
next: ChatGPT shipped this recipe to the public eight months later.
inherits: The post-training stack every assistant uses.
